thread:
lucy: noticed an uptick in TLS renegotiation errors on interregion egress from eu-west to us-east (service mesh) after we enforced TLS 1.3 minimum on the egress gate. Logs: 'tls: unsupported protocol' and 'handshake failure'.

hamid: are we sure old sidecars still support TLS1.3-only? Some older libc/openssl builds might negotiate 1.2.

lucy: KMS audits show decrypt OK; this looks like cipher mismatch. Packet capture shows ClientHello with TLS1.2 and server only accepts >=1.3.

sec-oncall: mitigation options? relax TLS policy temporarily or roll upgrade sidecars.

lucy: if we relax policy we risk exposing legacy ciphers. Better to do staggered sidecar upgrade in us-east and add an automated preflight that checks TLS version negotiation.

hamid: I'll coordinate the sidecar upgrade. We should add an alert: if TLS version negotiation <1.3 rate > 1/min -> page infra.

audit-bot: creating audit entry for the policy enforcement change.

deploy-bot: sidecar upgrade chart bumped to v2.7.0, canary scheduled. CI green.
